correctness.rationale: Reconstructed equations (1)–(9) from frozen RESULT.md. Complex phase averaging of ∥u_j+e^{it}u_k∥_4^4 yields exactly 4S_jk and, using fourth-power distortion of the two-coordinate input, S_jk≤ε. Keeping each target row’s maximal column entry deletes fourth-power mass R≤∑_{j<k}S_jk≤Mε; Hölder on the source columns gives ∥A−A0∥≤d^(3/4)R^(1/4). Each remaining disjoint column has fourth power ≥1−(M+1)ε>0; normalizing gives a genuine isometry and the additive (M+1)ε bound. For Aδ(x,y)=(x,y,δ(x+y)), duality gives Δ=8δ^4. Any restricted isometry either has a zero column (distance ≥1) or zero third-row coefficient in at least one column (distance ≥δ); a displayed exact-isometric approximation has error δ+O(δ^4). This proves the limiting ratio 8^(−1/4) without relying on finite checks. Edge cases ε=0, d=2, n=d and complex phases are covered.
